svg.title: SleepEdit AI Assistant Privacy and Review Flow

g.text: SleepEdit AI Assistant Privacy and Review Flow
Ask question or request an edit
Validate image type and size locally
Get enabled model and maximum effort
[Feature is disabled or settings are invalid]
Normalize model and resolve requested effort
Screen current question, note, and selections
PHI refusal; nothing is sent externally
Keep history or clear all history if unsafe
This first provider response is only a safety/domain decision.
It is not the assistant answer.
PHI refusal; no answer request is sent
Answer request with store=false, no tools,
strict schema, and optional redacted image
Refusal; no answer schema is parsed
protocol references, and optional note proposal
Validate draft, node IDs, sizes, timestamp,
Get enabled model and maximum effort
[Feature is disabled or settings are invalid]
Normalize model and resolve requested effort
Screen instruction and current unsaved draft;
treat matching saved text as trusted
PHI refusal; nothing is sent externally
Keep history or clear all history if unsafe
One planning request with store=false, no tools,
strict operation schema, draft, and optional redacted image
Refusal; no plan schema is parsed
Validate schema and simulate every operation
Apply note replacement or protocol change plan
otherwise apply to the working editor state
AI output is never applied automatically.
The user reviews and explicitly applies a proposal.
